allow: Read-only git and GitHub operations (status, log, diff, show, fetch; gh pr/issue/run/release list, view, diff, checks).
Local builds and checks: npm ci/typecheck/build in a node:22-alpine container, docker build, docker run of locally built images, actionlint, renovate-config-validator.
Pushing non-default branches to origin and opening pull requests (gh pr create).
soft_deny: Merging pull requests (gh pr merge) — every merge to main triggers a push of lostiboy7/pfadi-app:develop to Docker Hub.
Creating tags or GitHub releases (gh release create, git push of tags) — a published release pushes a new :<tag> and :latest to Docker Hub.
Changing repository secrets, variables or settings (gh secret set, gh variable set, gh repo edit).
hard_deny: Force-pushing to main, deleting the main branch, or rewriting published history on main.
Deleting the GitHub repository, the Docker Hub repository, published releases or published image tags.
Committing or baking secrets into the image: .env, config/camps.json, Google/NextAuth credentials, Docker Hub tokens, or the corporate CA bundle.
environment: This is pfadi-app (GitHub muellefy/pfadi-app): a Next.js 15 / TypeScript Lagerplaner for a Pfadi (scout) group, combining eCamp and Google Drive with Google login (next-auth). Deployed via Docker Compose.

Docker image: lostiboy7/pfadi-app on Docker Hub. .github/workflows/docker.yml pushes :develop on every push to main that touches image files, and :<release-tag> + :latest when a GitHub release is published (pre-releases do not move :latest).

Dependencies are updated by Renovate (renovate.json): no schedule (PRs can open any time), minor/patch grouped, no automerge. Every PR runs the required "build-complete" check (Docker build incl. next build for amd64 + arm64 on native runners); branch protection also requires the PR branch to be up to date with main. The app is not started in CI — a local smoke run is the extra signal.

The developer machine sits behind a TLS-intercepting Zscaler proxy. npm/npx are not installed on the host; run Node tooling in a node:22-alpine container with --network=host, the *_PROXY env vars, and NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS pointing at a read-only mount of /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt. For docker build pass the bundle as --secret id=ca,src=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt (never COPY it into the image).

Commits and PR titles follow Conventional Commits as defined in docs/commit-convention.md (type(scope): summary). PRs are merged only with squash and merge (gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch); merge commits and rebase merges are disabled on the repository, and the PR title becomes the commit on main.
ACCESS POLICY: reading and local building are always fine. Anything that publishes (merges to main, releases, tags, Docker Hub pushes, repo secrets/settings) must be confirmed by the user first.
